units.en: On xinsi Li Yin, Court of the Imperial Stud director, became drafting officer and Hanlin academician.
units.literal: On xinsi, Court of the Imperial Stud director Li Yin was made Secretariat drafting officer and Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 辛亥，宰臣竇貞固加守司徒，蘇逢吉加守司空，蘇禹珪加左僕射，楊邠加右僕射，依前兼樞密使。
units.en: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was given Acting Minister of Education, Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works, Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Yang Bin Right Vice Director, all continuing as before with concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.
units.literal: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was given Acting Minister of Education; Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works; Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yang Bin Right Vice Director, all continuing as before with concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 戊寅，司徒、門下侍郎、平章事竇貞固奏，請修晉朝實錄。
units.en: On wuyin, the Minister of Education, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor Dou Zhengu memorialized requesting compilation of the Jin dynasty Veritable Records.
units.literal: On wuyin, the Minister of Education, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor Dou Zhengu memorialized, requesting compilation of the Jin dynasty Veritable Records.

units.zh: 壬戌，幽州節度使趙德鈞兼北面行營招討使，鎮州節度使範延光加檢校太傅。
units.en: On renxu Zhao Dejun of Youzhou became northern campaign commissioner and Fan Yanguang of Zhen inspector grand mentor.
units.literal: On renxu, Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was given added northern campaign headquarters commissioner; Zhen prefecture military commissioner Fan Yanguang was given Inspector Grand Mentor by inspection.

units.zh: 會晉昌軍節度使趙匡讚、鳳翔節度使侯益俱謀歸蜀，遂以虔釗為北面行營招討使，應接經營。
units.en: When Zhao Kuangzan of Jinchang and Hou Yi of Fengxiang both plotted to defect to Shu, Qianzhao was made northern-campaign pacification commissioner to coordinate the effort.
units.literal: It happened that the military governor of Jinchang Army Zhao Kuangzan and the military governor of Fengxiang Hou Yi both plotted to submit to Shu; thereupon Qianzhao was made northern-campaign pacification commissioner to receive and manage affairs.

units.zh: 俄而趙匡讚、侯益請昶出師，掠定三秦，因命虔釗與韓保貞等總師五萬出散關，雄武軍節度使何重建出隴右，奉鑾肅衛都虞候李廷珪出子午穀，會於雍州。
units.en: Soon Zhao and Hou urged Chang to march and seize the Three Qin. Chang ordered Qianzhao and Han Baozhen to lead fifty thousand men through San Pass, He Chongjian of Xiongwu to advance through Longyou, and Li Tinggui of the Imperial Escort to march through Ziwu Valley. All were to converge on Yong.
units.literal: Soon Zhao Kuangzan and Hou Yi requested that Chang send troops to raid and secure the Three Qin. Thereupon he ordered Qianzhao with Han Baozhen and others to command fifty thousand troops out through San Pass, the military governor of Xiongwu Army He Chongjian out through Longyou, and the chief adjutant of the Imperial Escort Guard Li Tinggui out through Ziwu Valley, to meet at Yong Prefecture.

units.zh: 時虔釗、福誠、保貞師次陳倉，謀不相葉，而侯益聞匡讚已去，廷珪班師，亦誠款中變，閉壘不出。
units.en: By then Qianzhao, Fucheng, and Baozhen had halted at Chencang and could not agree among themselves. Hou Yi heard that Kuangzan was gone and Tinggui had withdrawn, changed his mind about submitting, and shut himself behind his walls.
units.literal: At that time the armies of Qianzhao, Fucheng, and Baozhen halted at Chencang and would not cooperate with one another. Hou Yi heard Kuangzan had gone, Tinggui had withdrawn his army, and his own pledge of sincerity changed midway; he closed his ramparts and would not come out.

units.zh: 契丹寇澶州，以臨陣忸怩，為景延廣所誅。
units.en: When the Khitan attacked Chanzhou he shrank from the fight and was executed by Jing Yanguang.
units.literal: When the Khitan raided Chanzhou he hesitated before the battle line and was executed by Jing Yanguang.

units.zh: 以右丞王易簡為吏部侍郎；
units.en: Right Vice Director Wang Yijian was made Vice Minister of Personnel;
units.literal: Wang Yijian, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of Personnel;

units.zh: 許王從益，明宗之幼子也。
units.en: Prince Xu Congyi was Mingzong's youngest son.
units.literal: Prince Xu Congyi was Emperor Mingzong's youngest son.

units.zh: 晉高祖即位，以皇后即其姊也，乃養從益於宮中。
units.en: When Gaozu of Jin took the throne, the empress being his elder sister, Congyi was raised in the palace.
units.literal: When Gaozu of Jin took the throne, because the empress was his elder sister, Congyi was raised within the palace.

units.zh: 守陵開運末，契丹主至汴，以從益遙領曹州節度使，復封許王，與王妃尋歸西京。
units.en: While guarding the imperial tombs in late Kaiyun, the Khitan ruler reached Bian. Congyi was given titular command of Caozhou, again enfeoffed as Prince of Xu, and soon returned to the Western Capital with his consort.
units.literal: While guarding the tombs at the end of Kaiyun, the Khitan ruler came to Bian; Congyi was made titular military commissioner of Caozhou at a distance, again enfeoffed as Prince of Xu, and soon returned to the Western Capital with his princess consort.

units.zh: 漢高祖怒，車駕將至闕，從益與王妃俱賜死於私第，時年十七；
units.en: Gaozu of Han was enraged. As the imperial carriage neared the capital, Congyi and his consort were both ordered to die in their private residence. He was seventeen;
units.literal: Gaozu of Han was angry; as the imperial carriage was about to reach the palace, Congyi and his princess consort were both granted death in their private residence; he was seventeen years old;

units.zh: 從璨為權臣所忌，從益為強敵所脅，俱不得其死，亦良可傷哉！
units.en: Congcan was destroyed by a powerful minister, Congyi was coerced by a strong enemy—neither died a natural death. How lamentable!
units.literal: Congcan was resented by a powerful minister, Congyi was coerced by a strong enemy—neither met a natural death; this too is deeply lamentable!

units.zh: 長興末，封許王。
units.en: At the end of the Changxing era he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xu.
units.literal: At the end of Changxing he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xu.

units.zh: 〈（《五代史闕文》：漢高祖自太原起軍建號，至洛陽，會郭從義先入京師，受密旨殺王淑妃與許王從益。
units.en: (Lost Writings of the History of the Five Dynasties records that Gaozu of Han raised his army at Taiyuan and established his reign. Reaching Luoyang, he found Guo Congyi already in the capital with a secret order to kill Consort Wang Shufei and Prince Xu Congyi.
units.literal: (Lost Writings of the History of the Five Dynasties: Gaozu of Han raised an army at Taiyuan and established his reign; reaching Luoyang, he met Guo Congyi, who had entered the capital first and received a secret order to kill Consort Wang Shufei and Prince Xu Congyi.

units.zh: 晉天福中，以從益為二王後，改封郇國公，食邑三千戶。
units.en: During Jin Tianfu he was made heir to the second princely rank, retitled Duke of Xun, with a fief of three thousand households.
units.literal: During Tianfu of Jin, Congyi was made heir to the second prince rank, his title was changed to Duke of Xun, and his fief was three thousand households.

units.zh: 乃詐稱契丹主命，遣人迎從益於洛陽，令知南朝軍國事。
units.en: so he falsely claimed the Khitan ruler's command, sent men to summon Congyi from Luoyang, and installed him to govern the southern court's military and civil affairs.
units.literal: therefore he falsely claimed the Khitan ruler's command, sent men to welcome Congyi from Luoyang, and ordered him to manage the military and civil affairs of the southern court.

units.zh: 會契丹主死，其汴州節度使蕭翰謀歸北地，慮中原無主，軍民大亂，則己亦不得按轡徐歸矣；
units.en: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north. He feared that with no ruler in the Central Plains and army and people in chaos, he himself could not withdraw at leisure;
units.literal: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north and feared that with no ruler in central China and army and people in great disorder, he himself would be unable to rein in his horse and withdraw at leisure;

units.zh: 時人哀之。
units.en: and the people pitied him.
units.literal: people of the time pitied him.

units.zh: 從益於崇元殿見群官。
units.en: Congyi received the assembled officials in Chongyuan Hall.
units.literal: Congyi received the assembled officials in Chongyuan Hall.

units.zh: 從益與王妃逃於徽陵以避之，使者至，不得已而赴焉。
units.en: Congyi and his consort fled to Huiling to escape the summons; when the envoys arrived, he had no choice but to go.
units.literal: Congyi and his princess consort fled to Huiling to avoid this; when the envoys arrived, unable to refuse, he went to them.

units.zh: 翰北歸，從益餞於北郊。
units.en: When Xiao Han marched north, Congyi gave him a farewell feast at the Northern Suburb.
units.literal: When Han returned north, Congyi gave a farewell feast at the Northern Suburb.

units.zh: 及漢高祖將離太原，從益召高行周、武行德欲拒漢高祖，行周等不從，且奏其事。
units.en: When Gaozu of Han was about to march from Taiyuan, Congyi summoned Gao Xingzhou and Wu Xingde to resist him. They refused and memorialized the court.
units.literal: When Gaozu of Han was about to leave Taiyuan, Congyi summoned Gao Xingzhou and Wu Xingde, wishing to resist Gaozu of Han; Xingzhou and the others would not obey and moreover memorialized the matter.

units.zh: 以嚴衛左右廂都指揮使、岩州刺史皇甫遇為忠正軍節度使、檢校太保，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。
units.en: Huangfu Yu, commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard and prefect of Yanzhou, was made commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed commander of the imperial infantry.
units.literal: Commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard, Yanzhou prefect Huangfu Yu was made Zhongzheng Army military commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry.

units.zh: 甲申，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、寧國軍節度使安彥威為河中節度使；
units.en: On jiashen An Yanwei, commander of the imperial cavalry and commissioner of the Ningguo Army, was made commissioner of Hezhong;
units.literal: On jiashen Commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, Ningguo Army military commissioner An Yanwei was made Hezhong military commissioner;

units.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、忠正軍節度使張從賓為涇州節度使，並加檢校太傅；
units.en: Zhang Congbin, commander of the imperial infantry and commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, was made commissioner of Jingzhou; both were advanced honorary Grand Mentor;
units.literal: Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry, Zhongzheng Army military commissioner Zhang Congbin was made Jingzhou military commissioner, both advanced honorary Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 辛卯，鄴都留守張從恩遣人夜縋城間行，奏契丹主以鐵騎三四萬建牙帳於元城，以趙延壽為魏博節度使，改封魏王，延壽日率騎軍摩壘而退。
units.en: On xinmao Yedu garrison commander Zhang Congen sent men down the wall by night with a secret report: the Khitan ruler had pitched camp at Yuancheng with 30,000–40,000 armored horsemen, made Zhao Yanshou Weibo commissioner and Prince of Wei, and Yanshou daily led cavalry to skirmish at the walls before withdrawing.
units.literal: On xinmao, Zhang Congen, garrison commander of Yedu, sent men at night to lower themselves by rope from the wall and travel by secret paths, memorializing that the Khitan ruler had set up his command tent at Yuancheng with thirty or forty thousand iron cavalry, made Zhao Yanshou military commissioner of Weibo and changed his enfeoffment to Prince of Wei; Yanshou daily led cavalry to press the ramparts and then withdraw.

units.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，是夕陣雲掩北斗之魁星。
units.en: On the first day jiaxu of the first month of spring in Kaiyun 1, battle clouds that night veiled the leader star of the Northern Dipper.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, first day jiaxu of the first year of Kaiyun, that night battle clouds covered the leader star of the Northern Dipper.

units.zh: 以河東掌書記馮道為戶部侍郎，充翰林學士；
units.en: Hedong secretary Feng Dao became vice minister of revenue and Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Hedong secretarial aide Feng Dao was made vice minister of revenue and Hanlin academician;

units.zh: 同光元年春正月丙子，五台山僧獻銅鼎三，言於山中石崖間得之。
units.en: In spring of Tongguang 1, on bingzi in the first month, monks of Mount Wutai presented three bronze tripods, saying they had found them in the stone cliffs of the mountains.
units.literal: In spring of the first year of Tongguang, on the first month, day bingzi, monks of Mount Wutai presented three bronze tripods, saying they had obtained them from among the stone cliffs in the mountains.

units.zh: 癸亥，以六軍諸衛判官、給事中張允為右散騎常侍。
units.en: On guihai Zhang Yun, reviewing secretary of the Six Armies and palace guards and Supervising Secretary, was made Right Regular Attendant.
units.literal: On guihai, Zhang Yun, reviewing secretary of the Six Armies and palace guards and Supervising Secretary, was made Right Regular Attendant.

units.zh: 曹國珍，字彥輔，幽州固安人也。
units.en: Cao Guozhen, whose courtesy name was Yanfu, came from Gu'an in You Prefecture.
units.literal: Cao Guozhen, courtesy name Yanfu, was a man of Gu'an in You Prefecture.

units.zh: 國珍少值燕薊亂離，因落發被緇，客於河西延州，高萬興兄弟皆好文，辟為從事。
units.en: In his youth Guozhen lived through the chaos and displacement of Yan and Ji. He tonsured himself and wore the black robe of a monk, then lived as a guest at Yan Prefecture west of the River, where Gao Wanxing and his brothers, all lovers of literature, recruited him as an aide.
units.literal: Guozhen in his youth encountered the chaos and displacement of Yan and Ji; he therefore tonsured himself and wore the black robe of a monk, living as a guest at Yan Prefecture west of the River. The brothers Gao Wanxing all loved literature and recruited him as an aide.

units.zh: 國珍常以文章自許，求貢禮闈，且掌書奏，期年，入為左拾遺，累遷至尚書郎。
units.en: Guozhen often prided himself on his writing. He sought advancement through the metropolitan examination while also managing memorial drafts, and within a year he entered court as Left Reminder, rising in succession to become a Director in the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: Guozhen often prided himself on his literary compositions; he sought advancement through the metropolitan examination and also managed memorial drafts. Within a year he entered court as Left Reminder and was promoted in succession to become a Director in the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 高祖在藩時，嘗通私謁，以兄事之。
units.en: When Gaozu was still a prince, Guozhen had once paid him a private visit and treated him as an elder brother.
units.literal: When Gaozu was still a prince, Guozhen had once visited him privately and treated him as an elder brother.

units.zh: 及即位，國珍自比於嚴陵，上表敘舊，由是自吏部郎中拜左諫議大夫、給事中。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Guozhen compared himself to Yan Ling and submitted a memorial recounting their old connection. He was therefore promoted from Director in the Ministry of Personnel to Left Remonstrance Grand Master and Chief Drafting Secretary.
units.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, Guozhen compared himself to Yan Ling and submitted a memorial recounting their old connection; he was therefore promoted from Director in the Ministry of Personnel to Left Remonstrance Grand Master and Chief Drafting Secretary.

units.zh: 〈（《歐陽史·張彥澤傳》：國珍與御史中丞王易簡率三院御史詣閣門，連疏論張彥澤，不報。）〉
units.en: (Ouyang Shi, Biography of Zhang Yanze: Guozhen and Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian led the censors of the three bureaus to the Gate of Imperial Audience and submitted successive memorials denouncing Zhang Yanze, but received no response.)〉
units.literal: (Ouyang Shi, Biography of Zhang Yanze: Guozhen and Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian led the censors of the three bureaus to the Gate of Imperial Audience and submitted successive memorials denouncing Zhang Yanze, but received no response.)〉

units.zh: 又求為御史中丞，時宰政不復為請，國珍銜之。
units.en: He also requested appointment as Censor-in-Chief, but the chief ministers did not petition on his behalf again, and Guozhen resented it.
units.literal: He also requested appointment as Censor-in-Chief, but the chief ministers did not again petition on his behalf; Guozhen resented this.

units.zh: 李崧之母薨，遣諸弟護喪歸葬深州，崧既起復，乃出北郊路隅設奠，公卿大夫皆送喪而出，國珍固爭不行，眾鹹推其讜直。
units.en: When Li Song's mother died, he sent his younger brothers to escort the body home for burial in Shen Prefecture. Song had already returned to office after mourning and set out offerings at a roadside outside the northern suburbs. High ministers and officials all went out to send off the funeral procession, but Guozhen firmly objected and refused to go, and everyone praised his forthright integrity.
units.literal: When Li Song's mother died, he sent his younger brothers to escort the funeral home for burial in Shen Prefecture. Since Song had already returned to office after mourning, he set out offerings at a roadside outside the northern suburbs. High ministers and officials all went out to send off the funeral procession, but Guozhen firmly objected and would not go; everyone praised his forthright integrity.

units.zh: 高祖晏駕，朝廷以宰臣馮道為山陵使，及靈盾既發，國珍上疏言：「馮道既為山陵使，不得復入都城，請除外佐，以桑維翰入輔。
units.en: When Gaozu passed away, the court appointed Chief Minister Feng Dao commissioner for the imperial tomb. After the spirit shield had been dispatched, Guozhen submitted a memorial stating, "Since Feng Dao has been made commissioner for the imperial tomb, he should not again enter the capital. I request that outside auxiliary officials be appointed and that Sang Weihan enter to assist in governance.
units.literal: When Gaozu passed away, the court appointed Chief Minister Feng Dao as commissioner for the imperial tomb. After the spirit shield had been dispatched, Guozhen submitted a memorial stating: "Since Feng Dao has been made commissioner for the imperial tomb, he should not again enter the capital; I request that auxiliary officials outside the capital be appointed, and that Sang Weihan enter to assist in governance.

units.zh: 少帝覽奏，以所言侵越，出為陜州行軍司馬。
units.en: The Lesser Emperor reviewed the memorial and, deeming his words presumptuous and overstepping, dispatched him to serve as military adjutant at Shaan Prefecture.
units.literal: The Lesser Emperor reviewed the memorial and, deeming his words presumptuous and overstepping, dispatched him to serve as military adjutant at Shaan Prefecture.

units.zh: 曾祖藹，祖蟾，父絢，代襲儒素。
units.en: His great-grandfather was Ai, his grandfather Chan, and his father Xuan; for generations the family had upheld the tradition of plain Confucian scholar-officials.
units.literal: His great-grandfather was Ai, his grandfather Chan, and his father Xuan; generation after generation they inherited the tradition of plain Confucian scholar-officials.

units.zh: 性頗剛僻，經藝史學，非其所長，好自矜衒，多上章疏，文字差誤，數數有之，為縉紳所誚。
units.en: His nature was obstinate and aloof. Classical studies and historical learning were not his strengths, yet he loved to show himself off. He submitted many memorials, and textual errors in them occurred again and again, for which the gentry mocked him.
units.literal: His nature was rather obstinate and aloof. Classical studies and historical learning were not his strengths, yet he loved to show himself off. He submitted many memorials and petitions, and textual errors in them occurred repeatedly, for which the gentry mocked him.

units.zh: 每與人交，傾財無吝。
units.en: Whenever he associated with others, he spent his wealth freely and without stint.
units.literal: Whenever he associated with others, he spent his wealth freely without stint.

units.zh: 李崧請罷相位，俾持喪制。」
units.en: Li Song should be asked to relinquish his chancellorship so that he may observe mourning."
units.literal: Li Song should be asked to relinquish his chancellorship so that he may observe mourning."

units.zh: 至任悒怏，遘疾而卒。
units.en: Upon reaching his post he was discontent; he fell ill and died.
units.literal: Upon reaching his post he was discontent; he fell ill and died.

units.zh: 掌書記桑維翰、都押衙劉知遠贊成密計，遂拒末帝之命。
units.en: Chief secretary Sang Weihan and chief escort officer Liu Zhiyuan endorsed the secret plan, and he therefore refused the Last Emperor's command.
units.literal: Chief secretary Sang Weihan and chief escort officer Liu Zhiyuan endorsed the secret plan, and he therefore refused the Last Emperor's command.

units.zh: 帝尋命桑維翰詣諸道求援，契丹遣人復書諾之，約以中秋赴義。
units.en: The Emperor soon sent Sang Weihan to the various circuits seeking aid. The Khitan sent a reply promising help and agreeing to come by the Mid-Autumn Festival.
units.literal: The Emperor soon ordered Sang Weihan to go to the various circuits seeking aid; the Khitan sent men with a reply promising help, agreeing to come to his aid by the Mid-Autumn Festival.

units.zh: 〈（《遼史太宗紀》云：七月丙申，唐河東節度使石敬瑭為其主所討，遣趙瑩求救，時趙德鈞亦遣使至，河東復遣桑維翰來告急，遂許興師。
units.en: (The 《Basic Annals of Taizong》 in the 《History of Liao》 states: On the bingshen day of the seventh month, Tang's Hedong military commissioner Shi Jingtang was attacked by his ruler and sent Zhao Ying to seek rescue. At that time Zhao Dejun also sent envoys, and Hedong again sent Sang Weihan to report urgency, whereupon the Khitan ruler permitted the raising of troops.
units.literal: (The 《Basic Annals of Taizong》 in the 《History of Liao》 states: On the bingshen day of the seventh month, Tang's Hedong military commissioner Shi Jingtang was attacked by his ruler and sent Zhao Ying to seek rescue; at that time Zhao Dejun also sent envoys, and Hedong again sent Sang Weihan to report urgency, whereupon he permitted the raising of troops.

units.zh: 己未，高麗王王建遣使貢方物。
units.en: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys with local tribute.
units.literal: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products.

units.zh: 敬瑭懼，幕僚段希堯請誅其倡者，敬瑭命劉知遠斬三十六人以殉。
units.en: Jingtang was afraid; his staff officer Duan Xiyao urged executing the ringleaders; Jingtang ordered Liu Zhiyuan to behead thirty-six men as a warning.
units.literal: Jingtang was afraid; his staff officer Duan Xiyao requested executing the ringleaders; Jingtang ordered Liu Zhiyuan to behead thirty-six men as a warning.

units.zh: 遣右武衛上將軍張彥澤等率勁騎三千以禦之。
units.en: Right Martial Guard senior general Zhang Yanzhe and others were sent with 3,000 elite cavalry to resist them.
units.literal: Zhang Yanzhe, senior general of the Right Martial Guard, and others were sent to lead three thousand crack cavalry to resist them.

units.zh: 丙申，契丹攻黎陽。
units.en: On bingshen the Khitan attacked Liyang.
units.literal: On bingshen, the Khitan attacked Liyang.

units.zh: 己丑，太子太傅劉句守司空兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。
units.en: On jichou Liu Ju, grand preceptor to the heir, was made acting Minister of Works with concurrent appointment as vice director of the Chancellery and associate grand councilor.
units.literal: On jichou Grand Preceptor to the Heir Liu Ju was made acting Minister of Works and concurrently Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 遣侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹領兵赴鄆州。
units.en: Palace Guards infantry commander Guo Jin was sent with troops to Yun.
units.literal: The Palace Guards infantry commander Guo Jin was dispatched to lead troops to Yunzhou.

units.zh: 以宣徽北院使房暠為左衛上將軍，充宣徽南院使；
units.en: Fang Hao, Northern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, was made General of the Left Guard and Southern Bureau commissioner;
units.literal: Fang Hao, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made General of the Left Guard and assigned as Commissioner of the Southern Bureau;

units.zh: 時李嗣源總帳下親軍攻東北隅；
units.en: Li Siyuan led the household guard against the northeast corner;
units.literal: Li Siyuan commanded the personal troops below the tent attacking the northeast corner;

units.zh: 李嗣源壞夾城東北隅，率先掩擊，梁軍大恐，南向而奔，投戈委甲，噎塞行路，斬萬餘級，獲其將副招討使符道昭洎大將三百人，芻粟百萬。
units.en: Li Siyuan breached Jiacity's northeast and charged in; Liang panicked and fled south, shedding arms until the road jammed; over ten thousand were killed; Fu Daozhao and three hundred officers were taken, with a million bundles of fodder.
units.literal: Li Siyuan broke the northeast corner of Jiacity and led the assault; the Liang army was greatly terrified and fled south, casting weapons and armor; the road was choked; more than ten thousand were beheaded; deputy pacification commissioner Fu Daozhao and three hundred great generals were captured, and a million measures of fodder.

units.zh: 五月辛未朔，晨霧晦暝，帝率親軍伏三垂崗下。
units.en: At the xinwei new moon in the fifth month, thick morning fog hid Cunxu's personal troops below Sanchui Ridge.
units.literal: On the first day xinwei of the fifth month, morning fog dark and dim, the Emperor led his personal army in ambush below Sanchui Ridge.
